research_family.rationale: Prospective V0.1 is long-only because current Numerical Risk Policy V2 is Spot 1x with no leverage. One timeframe minimizes degrees of freedom.

signal_rules.breakout: closed candle close > resistance AND close >= open
signal_rules.retest: within next 2 closed candles, first zone touch is decisive; low must remain >= zone_low and close >= zone_high
signal_rules.failed_retest: first zone touch closing below zone_high OR any low below zone_low before confirmation invalidates setup
signal_rules.entry: next closed-series candle open after defended retest confirmation
signal_rules.pre_entry_cancellation: if next entry open < zone_high, cancel
signal_rules.catalyst: NOT_REQUIRED_FOR_RESEARCH_ONLY; LIVE CATALYST POLICY REMAINS BLOCKED

cost_scenarios.name: FEE_FLOOR
cost_scenarios.interpretation: Research lower-bound sensitivity, not a claim of historical realized cost.

cost_scenarios.name: BASE_SENSITIVITY
cost_scenarios.interpretation: Pre-registered sensitivity assumption, not a claim of historical realized spread/slippage.

cost_sensitivity_policy.reason: Holding the BASE-selected cohort fixed prevents a higher-cost scenario from looking artificially better merely by dropping tighter-risk trades.

rr_cost_constraint.formula: for gross target mR, stop fraction s and round-trip cost fraction c: net_RR=(m*s-c)/(s+c)
rr_cost_constraint.purpose: structural feasibility check, not historical outcome tuning

stage_access_sequence: Do not fetch, download, read, summarize, chart, or inspect 2025 validation before P00 discovery is machine-classified SURVIVES.
If discovery is INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE or NO_EDGE, stop; do not use 2025 to rescue the hypothesis.
After unchanged P00 discovery SURVIVES, 2025 may be unlocked for validation without parameter changes.
2026 remains locked until unchanged P00 passes both stages and a separate explicit holdout unlock is authorized.
data_contract.listing_and_missing_data: No synthetic pre-listing history and no candle interpolation. Split at missing intervals; no setup may span a data gap.

offline_ingest_contract.rule: No dataset may reach P00 unless the offline ingest manifest is PASS or PASS_WITH_GAPS under the frozen ingest contract. Unknown raw MEXC schemas fail closed until a separately validated adapter is frozen.

trade_sampling_contract.reason: Portfolio capital allocation is not yet frozen and must not be invented.

uncertainty.target_metric: BASE_SENSITIVITY net_expectancy_R on BASE-selected P00 cohort
uncertainty.note: All trades from a sampled UTC day are resampled together to preserve within-day clustering.

discovery_survives_only_if: 95% day-block-bootstrap lower bound for BASE_SENSITIVITY net_expectancy_R > 0
validation_survives_only_if: 95% day-block-bootstrap lower bound for BASE_SENSITIVITY net_expectancy_R > 0
decision_policy.insufficient_sample: If minimum BASE-selected resolved-trade count is not met, classify INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE rather than extend/tune opportunistically.
decision_policy.no_edge: If a required survival condition fails, classify NO_EDGE for P00 at that stage. Do not promote a sensitivity profile as replacement.
decision_policy.validation_unlock: 2025 validation is inaccessible until unchanged P00 is machine-classified SURVIVES on discovery.
decision_policy.holdout_unlock: 2026 requires separate explicit authorization after unchanged P00 passes both discovery and validation.

live_blockers_remaining: Phase A completion under its independent contract
live catalyst policy or explicit catalyst-not-required authority
TradingView/Python geometry parity after research contract is frozen
